name: Grade 9 IIT Practice: July Week 5 - Collection Plan
description: Practice words for Grade 9 second-trimester Python and data work.

words.definition: A question that can be answered with data.
words.example: The data question asked which study habit helped students finish homework.

words.definition: Able to be counted or measured.
words.example: The group made the question measurable by counting minutes of practice.
The survey asked classmates to choose one answer from a short list.

words.definition: The kind of data, such as number or text.
words.example: The student identified age as a number data type and opinion as text.

words.definition: A command that performs an action on data.
words.example: The collection method was an anonymous Google Form.
The survey protected privacy by not asking for student names.
